scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && if [ -x ../../.venv/bin/python ]; then ../../.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi
scripts.test:api: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests/integration -p 'test_*_flow.py'; else python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/integration -p 'test_*_flow.py'; fi
scripts.test:api:migrations: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.integration.test_migration_flow; else python3 -m unittest tests.integration.test_migration_flow; fi
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:web && pnpm verify:python && pnpm test:api
